schema.description: Which service or solution the prospect is interested in, in their own words, based on the conversation and their form request.
What triggered the prospect's interest right now; the concrete pain or event behind the inquiry.
The prospect's timeline and how urgent the project is (e.g. 'within a month', 'exploring, no deadline').
Whether the prospect has past experience with automation/AI solutions and how that experience went.
Any budget range or financial readiness the prospect mentioned; 'not discussed' if it did not come up.
Three-sentence summary of the call in German: who, what they want, agreed next step.
true if the prospect wants a follow-up call with Erwin, false otherwise.
The agreed callback window for Erwin's follow-up call (weekday + morning/afternoon + any number correction), e.g. 'Dienstag vormittags, gleiche Nummer'; 'none' if no appointment was agreed.
The caller's name as understood; 'unknown' if not given.
The company the caller represents; 'none' for private calls.
One of: new_inquiry, existing_customer, partner_supplier, sales_spam, other.
Two-sentence summary of why they called and what was agreed, in German.
What the caller wants Erwin to do next, incl. preferred callback time if given.
true if the caller expects a callback from Erwin, false otherwise.
